releaseNotes:
• XP leaderboard — see where you stand against every other reader, ranked by lifetime XP.
• Opens on the top 100, with a "Show more" button for the rest.
• Your own rank sits pinned at the top, so you see your position straight away instead of paging to find yourself.
• Search the whole board by name or wallet address, not just the rows on screen.
• Readers who never set a username show a shortened wallet address, so every row stays distinguishable.

Find it under Daily Quests → XP leaderboard.
